intro: Below are representative engagements highlighting the kinds of systems I have delivered, the constraints I navigated, and the outcomes that mattered to stakeholders.

projects.title: Platform reliability for a high-traffic product
projects.summary: Backend and observability work for a consumer-facing service.

problems.title: Intermittent latency spikes under peak load
problems.context: Event-driven microservices on Kubernetes; traffic doubled during campaigns.
problems.problem: P95 latency exceeded SLO during peak windows. On-call was reactive; root causes were unclear across service boundaries.
problems.resolution: Added RED metrics and distributed traces, identified a hot path in a downstream dependency, introduced caching with explicit TTLs, and right-sized worker pools. Documented a lightweight incident review template.
problems.outcome: P95 latency dropped back under SLO for peak traffic; on-call pages decreased materially for the quarter.

problems.title: Slow feature delivery due to fragile deployment pipeline
problems.context: Multiple teams sharing a monolithic release train.
problems.problem: Releases were infrequent and risky; rollbacks were manual and stressful.
problems.resolution: Split deployable units, added canary deploys with automated health gates, and moved critical checks earlier in CI.
problems.outcome: Lead time for changes improved; failed deployments became rare and recoverable within minutes.

plan306090.days30: Build context: map stakeholders, services, and SLOs. Ship small observability wins and fix the top one or two reliability gaps.
plan306090.days60: Deepen impact: own a meaningful slice of the roadmap, reduce toil through automation, and align metrics with business outcomes.
plan306090.days90: Lead by example: drive a cross-team initiative (performance, security, or developer experience), mentor others, and leave durable runbooks and architecture notes.
